caption:
Four stripes. A new first. ✈️

Rita Nasirumbi has become Uganda Airlines’ first female captain—a milestone the carrier announced on October 13, 2026.

Nasirumbi has flown with the airline since its revival in 2019. Her promotion puts her in command of its CRJ900 regional jets, adding a fourth stripe and a new level of responsibility to a career that has grown alongside the carrier.

Her former school, Immaculate Heart Girls’ School in Nyakibale, is celebrating the achievement too, pointing its students toward an aviation career they can now see represented by one of their own.

For girls imagining a future on the flight deck, that visibility matters. Congratulations, Captain Nasirumbi—here’s to the next generation following you into the left seat! 👏

Sources: Immaculate Heart Girls’ School; Pulse Uganda, October 14, 2026.
